free_text.question: Which publicly listed US company reported these financial statements? Answer with the company name and stock ticker only.
free_text.scoring: Match an upper-case SEC ticker as a separate token, or a normalized current or post-2019 former SEC entity name with legal suffixes removed.

forced_choice.question: Which of these companies reported these financial statements?
forced_choice.candidate_selection: Sample four distractors without replacement from the sorted primary-panel firm identifiers excluding the true firm, append the true firm, then shuffle with the same generator.
forced_choice.candidate_names: Current SEC entity names; convert all-capital names to title case.
forced_choice.candidate_reuse: The candidate set and order are identical across arms and models for each observation.
forced_choice.scoring: Choose the letter with the largest saved answer-token log probability; normalize over A-E for the probability on the true firm.

inference: CR1 firm-clustered 95% intervals for rates and contrasts.
